description: This file defines classes and functions related to the internal configuration management of Playwright test runner, including classes for full configuration and project configurations, utility functions for resolving dependencies, reporters, and scripts, as well as constants and type definitions.

classes.name: FullConfigInternal
classes.description: Represents the internal full configuration for Playwright tests, including setup of projects, plugins, web servers, and CLI options.

classes.name: FullProjectInternal
classes.description: Represents an internal project configuration within the full Playwright test configuration, including test directory, retries, dependencies, and other project-specific settings.

methods.name: takeFirst
methods.description: Utility function to return the first defined argument among its parameters.

methods.name: pathResolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative path against a base directory.

methods.name: resolveReporters
methods.description: Resolves reporter configurations into a standardized format with absolute paths.

methods.name: resolveWorkers
methods.description: Converts a string or number into a numeric worker count, supporting percentages.

methods.name: resolveProjectDependencies
methods.description: Resolves project dependencies and teardowns, ensuring correctness and uniqueness.

methods.name: toReporters
methods.description: Converts reporter configuration into an array of reporter descriptions.

methods.name: resolveScript
methods.description: Resolves a script path relative to a root directory or via require.resolve.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique project ID assigned internally.
